items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had a little saxophone with me from Boston, Massachusetts named Smiley Thompson. He could play... And the guy that we played for was the President of the Cattle Owners' Association of the State of Idaho.

ctx.x: Benny Goodman tried to find me. They all tried to find me, you know. But I was happy with the group back in again, and this was a nice salary, with room and board. I had a little saxophone with me from Boston, Massachusetts named Smiley Thompson. He could play. A little bitty guy, but he was tight financially. And I got to tell you, this is real funny. And the guy that we played for was the President of the Cattle Owners' Association of the State of Idaho. And we had nothin' but steaks, you know, food. Anything…
